id: AT-RN-10 (repo-based publish cases from a checkout under /tmp)
note: 0.1.4 T-8: the publish lint treats paths under /tmp, /private/tmp and /var/folders as ephemeral, so from a checkout under a temp root (its git-ignored tmp/ folder, where the tmp_base "repo" cases work, then lies under one) 48 of the 51 repo-based cases failed: each publishes a body naming its own work folder (the other 3 publish none). In test mode, STORE_TEST_EPHEMERAL_EXEMPT=<folder> (the runner sets it to a tmp_base "repo" case's work folder) makes a path at or under it not ephemeral; the temp-root list is unchanged. A child run of those 48 with --repo-tmp under /tmp passes them all, HT-PB-01 among them, whose /tmp path outside the work folder still refuses (its step pins line 22 alone). The seam itself: a path at or under the folder, /private/tmp and /private/var read as /tmp and /var on either side; a sibling whose name only starts with the folder's, a relative folder or one with a .. part exempts nothing (review F-3)

steps.name: the seam: a path at or under the exempt folder, read with macOS's /private/tmp and /private/var as /tmp and /var either way; a sibling folder whose name starts with it, or an exempt folder with a .. part, is not exempt (review F-3: mutants r-t8-noprivate, r-t8-sibling)
the 48 repo-based cases that publish their work folder, with the repo tmp folder under /tmp
